text.zh_cn:
死亡并非终点，只要手中紧握着它。
- 手持 [item:minecraft:totem_of_undying] 死亡时免死并回血
- 副手同样生效
- 掠夺 III 提升 [entity:minecraft:vindicator] 掉落它的几率
> 薪火未熄，人便不死。
text.en_us:
Death is not the end while this is in hand.
- Hold [item:minecraft:totem_of_undying] to cheat death and heal
- It also works in the offhand
- Looting III raises the drop chance from [entity:minecraft:vindicator]
> While the flame lingers, you cannot truly die.
